VeraGrid.Gui.AiAgent.generate_knowledge_assets module

Generate packaged AI knowledge assets for VeraGrid.

This script converts selected repository sources into markdown knowledge files that ship with the AI agent. The generated files are written under VeraGrid/Gui/AiAgent/knowledge so the retrieval layer can load them through package resources in production builds.

class VeraGrid.Gui.AiAgent.generate_knowledge_assets.KnowledgeAsset(output_name: str, content: str)[source]

  • content – Markdown content to write.
